parameters.jsCode: const ctx = $input.item.json; const raw = (ctx.rawText || '').trim(); let matchedIntent = ctx.intent || null; let confidence = matchedIntent ? 1.0 : 0.0; let reason = matchedIntent ? 'Explicit intent provided' : null; let extractedParams = { episode_number: ctx.episode_no || ctx.episode_number || null, mode: ctx.mode || null, character_name: null, voice_id: null }; const epNumMatch = raw.match(/(?:ep(?:isode)?\s*#?\s*|#)([0-9]{1,4})\b/i); if (epNumMatch) extractedParams.episode_number = parseInt(epNumMatch[1], 10); if (!matchedIntent && /^[#*!]/.test(raw)) { const cmdBody = raw.replace(/^[#*!]+\s*/, '').trim().toLowerCase(); const prefixRules = [{ pattern: /^ep(?:isode)?\s+\d+.*(?:regen|retry|redo)/i, intent: 'REGENERATE_EPISODE' }, { pattern: /^regen(?:erate)?\s+ep/i, intent: 'REGENERATE_EPISODE' }, { pattern: /^cont(?:inue)?\s+ep/i, intent: 'CONTINUE_EPISODE' }, { pattern: /^ep(?:isode)?\s+\d+/i, intent: 'GENERATE_EPISODE' }, { pattern: /^(?:reel|short)\b/i, intent: 'QUICK_GENERATE_REEL' }, { pattern: /^(?:vid|video|quick_video)\b/i, intent: 'QUICK_GENERATE_VIDEO' }, { pattern: /^(?:img|image|quick_image)\b/i, intent: 'QUICK_GENERATE_IMAGE' }]; for (const rule of prefixRules) { if (rule.pattern.test(cmdBody)) { matchedIntent = rule.intent; confidence = 1.0; reason = 'Layer 1 match'; break; } } } return { json: { ...ctx, skip_llm: matchedIntent !== null, classification: matchedIntent ? { intent: matchedIntent, confidence, reason, extracted_params: extractedParams, classifier_layer: 'LAYER_1_PREFIX' } : null }, binary: $input.item.binary || {} };
